When it detects a person, the camera automatically follows the movement and sends alerts to your mobile device. After the detected individual leaves the camera's range, it automatically returns to its preset Guard Position.

 

7. 24/7 Cloud And SD Card Storage & Multi-Device Sharing: This Triple-lens PTZ camera for outdoor home security offers 24/7 surveillance with footage storage options.
